Agentic retrieval / RAG-as-decision-loop (the RAG default is under attack from three sides at once - Sierra's Context Engine compiles what a business knows into a stateful context layer, InsightEmb trains embeddings on action intent rather than surface text, and the vectorless-RAG argument says structured data never needed similarity search; HN's best taxonomy of the day says agentic search today is late-interaction retrieval, a smarter harness, or just grep)

Vector DB market (the 'do you still need a dedicated vector DB' question got three answers in one day and none of them was yes - vectorless RAG where the data already carries enough structure, action-intent embeddings instead of lexical similarity, and the practitioner default landing on pgvector-until-it-hurts; RAGFlow is the only classical RAG engine still holding a trending slot)

Context engineering (the frame is being renamed in real time - three of today's Medium pieces on it argue the durable layer is the harness rather than the context window: compress conversation history, offload large tool results to a filesystem instead of the prompt, isolate subagent context, keep a retrieval path back to the original evidence; the topic's own territory is being annexed by 'AI control plane')

Enterprise agent platforms (US Army Human Resources Command deploys Agentforce for 9.2 million soldiers, veterans and families — one of the largest named agentic deployments by user population — with Salesforce separately clearing DoD Impact Level 5; ServiceNow's AI Control Tower reaches GA with 30 new AWS/Google Cloud/Azure/SAP/Oracle/Workday integrations; A2A argued as the cross-functional layer over siloed per-function SAP assistants)

Agentic retrieval / RAG-as-decision-loop (Beyond Top-K replaces the opaque top-K dense call with explicit, inspectable retrieval operations the agent composes itself; Selective Context Preference Optimization trains the model to decide when retrieved context deserves trust versus parametric knowledge — the core production-RAG failure mode — with code and MIST-Bench released; NeSy-RAG makes the answer carry a checkable derivation)

Vector DB market under pressure (retrieval is collapsing back into the data platform — IBM Research builds filtered ANN out of Iceberg-style table-format pruning plus per-file indexes instead of a dedicated vector database, and SAP-Snowflake zero-copy reaches GA with CSN semantic views feeding Cortex Analyst and Cortex Code building agents on top without ETL; two independent moves against a bolt-on vector tier in one day)

Context engineering (LangChain publishes concrete thresholds instead of generalities — tool responses over 20,000 tokens offloaded to the filesystem and replaced with a path plus a 10-line preview, old write/edit arguments truncated to file pointers at 85% of the window, summarization only when offloading is exhausted; the transferable idea is the eval methodology, deliberately triggering compression at 10-25% of the window to manufacture enough events to compare implementations, with goal drift as the worst failure mode)
